title: India conducts successful test of Agni-V MIRV ballistic missile
summary: India successfully tested the Agni-V missile fitted with Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicles (MIRV) technology, making it capable of striking multiple targets simultaneously. The test, conducted from APJ Abdul Kalam Island, marks a significant leap in India's strategic deterrence capability.
ssb_importance: Critical for officers — demonstrates awareness of India's strategic assets and nuclear deterrence modernization under Mission Divyastra.
gd_topic: Is MIRV technology a stabilizing or destabilizing force in South Asia's nuclear landscape?
lecturette: India's Ballistic Missile Programme and Strategic Deterrence
interview_question: What is the strategic significance of MIRV technology for India's second-strike capability?

title: Indian Navy commissions INS Nilgiri, first of Project 17A stealth frigates
summary: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Nilgiri, the lead ship of the Project 17A stealth frigate programme built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders. The warship features advanced stealth features, supersonic BrahMos missiles, and indigenous combat management systems, reflecting India's Aatmanirbhar Bharat vision in shipbuilding.
ssb_importance: Demonstrates India's growing indigenous naval capability and the Blue Water Navy ambitions critical for IOR dominance.
gd_topic: Is India's indigenous warship-building programme sufficient to meet blue-water naval ambitions?
lecturette: Project 17A Frigates and India's Naval Modernisation Drive
interview_question: How does the commissioning of INS Nilgiri strengthen India's position as a net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region?

title: DRDO successfully tests Pralay surface-to-surface tactical ballistic missile
summary: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) conducted a successful flight test of the Pralay quasi-ballistic surface-to-surface missile. With a range of 150–500 km, Pralay fills a critical tactical gap and will be deployed by both Army and Navy for precision strike operations.
ssb_importance: Highlights India's accelerated indigenous defence production and the push for tactical precision strike capability under Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
gd_topic: Tactical ballistic missiles: Do they escalate or deter regional conflict?
lecturette: DRDO's Role in India's Missile Self-Reliance
interview_question: How do tactical missiles like Pralay complement India's conventional deterrence strategy along the northern borders?

title: ISRO's NISAR satellite launch scheduled — joint mission with NASA
summary: ISRO and NASA are finalizing preparations for the launch of the NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) satellite, the world's most expensive Earth observation satellite. NISAR will provide crucial data on glacial movements, forest cover, earthquakes, and coastal erosion, with direct implications for national security and disaster management.
ssb_importance: Space-based surveillance and dual-use technology are increasingly critical for modern national security — an officer must be aware of these developments.
gd_topic: Should India prioritize military or civilian space applications for maximum national benefit?
lecturette: ISRO's International Partnerships and India's Space Diplomacy
interview_question: How does NISAR's earth observation capability contribute to India's border surveillance and disaster preparedness?

title: India and France sign deal for 26 Rafale Marine jets for Indian Navy
summary: India signed a government-to-government deal with France for the acquisition of 26 Rafale Marine fighter jets for the Indian Navy, to be deployed on INS Vikrant. The deal worth approximately ₹63,000 crore includes Transfer of Technology (ToT) provisions and a significant offset component for Indian industry.
ssb_importance: Major procurement decisions shape India's military readiness and strategic partnerships — an officer needs to understand the strategic calculus behind defence partnerships.
gd_topic: India-France defence partnership: Strategic necessity or over-dependence on foreign OEMs?
lecturette: India's Aircraft Carrier Programme and Naval Aviation
interview_question: Why is carrier-based aviation critical for India's power projection capability in the Indo-Pacific?

title: India-China LAC disengagement: Patrolling resumes at Depsang and Demchok
summary: Following the 2024 LAC disengagement agreement, Indian and Chinese troops have fully resumed patrolling at Depsang Plains and Demchok in eastern Ladakh. Diplomatic sources confirm buffer zones are being phased out and normal patrolling protocols reinstated, marking the biggest reset in India-China border relations since the 2020 Galwan standoff.
ssb_importance: The LAC standoff and its resolution is one of the most significant geopolitical events of the decade — direct relevance to GD and PI topics on India-China relations.
gd_topic: India-China normalisation: Pragmatic diplomacy or strategic concession?
lecturette: India-China Border Dispute: History, Galwan, and the Road Ahead
interview_question: As a future officer, how would you assess the strategic implications of the LAC patrolling resumption at Depsang?

title: India's defence exports cross ₹23,000 crore — new record for Aatmanirbhar Bharat
summary: India's defence exports have surpassed ₹23,000 crore in the current fiscal year, setting a new record and demonstrating the success of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative in the defence sector. Key export items include BrahMos missiles, Akash air defence systems, and various ammunition, with exports going to over 85 countries.
ssb_importance: Rising defence exports reflect India's growing military-industrial strength — a key talking point for GDs on self-reliance and economic power.
gd_topic: Can India become a global top-10 defence exporter by 2030?
lecturette: Aatmanirbhar Bharat in Defence: Progress, Challenges, and the Road Ahead
interview_question: How do defence exports contribute to India's overall foreign policy objectives and soft power?

title: CDS Gen Anil Chauhan outlines Integrated Theatre Command roadmap for 2026
summary: Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan has outlined the roadmap for establishing Integrated Theatre Commands (ITCs), proposing the creation of the Peninsula Command and the Mountain Command as priority structures. ITCs aim to break service-specific silos and enable faster, joint military decision-making during conflicts.
ssb_importance: Theaterisation is the most significant structural reform in the Indian military in decades — every SSB aspirant must understand its scope and challenges.
gd_topic: Integrated Theatre Commands: Is India's military ready for jointmanship?
lecturette: India's Military Theaterisation and the Role of the Chief of Defence Staff
interview_question: What challenges does theaterisation face in the Indian context, and how can they be overcome?
